title: block-noncanonical-commit telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the block-noncanonical-commit guard. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "block-noncanonical-commit". Evolves additive-only. Carries NO full command string or commit message body.

tool.description: The invoking tool — "Bash" or "PowerShell"; this guard matches both.

subject.description: Privacy-safe command subject: `Bash:<first-token>` for a Bash call, with leading sudo / env-assignment prefixes stripped and the token basenamed; the bare tool name (`PowerShell`) for a PowerShell call, which is not tokenized. NEVER the full command or its arguments.

form.description: The non-canonical commit-message form when blocked (e.g. "message-flag" for a bare -m/-F not paired with the canonical marker), or "alias-traversal-cap" when checking the command's git alias chain exceeded the re-expansion budget. "powershell-deferred" (status ok) when a PowerShell command was not faithfully tokenizable and the guard deferred without evaluating it. Empty string when the command was evaluated and allowed.
